no_threshold_notice: No product threshold, default or 'recommended' status follows from these numbers. Checked-in traces are synthetic and a threshold sweep only shows the phantom/recall trade-off on the trace it ran on. A facial switch is not recommended until false-activation evidence exists from real volunteer sessions across people (design/eye-control/ROADMAP.md P5.4, ADR-v2-150).
zero_denominator_rule: An empty trace is refused. A rate whose own denominator is zero is reported as {"value": null, "reason": ...}, never as 0.0: no non-deliberate time -> not_measured; no deliberate gestures -> not_measured; non-deliberate time with no usable reading -> tracking_unavailable.

metric_definitions.false_activations: switch starts outside every deliberate window (one per action, not per frame)
metric_definitions.false_activations_per_hour: false_activations / (non-deliberate seconds / 3600); non-deliberate time is every sample outside a deliberate window, tracked or not
metric_definitions.false_activations_per_hour_lower_95: exact one-sided 95% Poisson lower limit of the same rate (0 when no phantom was seen); with the upper limit, a two-sided 90% interval
metric_definitions.false_activations_per_hour_upper_95: exact one-sided 95% Poisson upper limit of the same rate
metric_definitions.per_hour_extrapolated: true when the exposure behind a per-hour figure is under one hour: the figure is scaled up from a shorter observation, and only the limits say how far to trust it
metric_definitions.recall: deliberate intervals with at least one start in their window / deliberate intervals
metric_definitions.activation_latency_ms: first start sample minus the deliberate interval's first sample, debounce included
metric_definitions.chatter: more than one start inside one deliberate window
metric_definitions.stuck_open_holds: holds still open at the first sample of a deliberate interval they did not begin in, or spanning a whole non-deliberate labelled segment: a switch that never let go
metric_definitions.longest_hold_s: the longest single hold, from its start to its end (or to the end of the trace if it never ended), in seconds
metric_definitions.failures: named failures present in this block; 'stuck_open' when stuck_open_holds > 0

upper_bound_caveat: Exact one-sided 95% Poisson lower and upper limits on the rate, assuming independent events in a single session; real phantoms cluster (a long conversation, a bad lighting spell), so treat them as a floor on the uncertainty, not a guarantee.
